steps.say: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Look at headings and first lines.
Scanning is looking quickly for one word, name or number.
Use a contents page, an index or a timetable to find information fast.

check.prompt: You want to find the price in a leaflet. What do you do?

options.text: scan for a number and the word price

options.why: This is too slow for a single fact.
Pictures may not show the price.

hints: Move your eyes quickly over the page.
check.explanation: Scanning helps you find a specific fact fast.

check.prompt: Which part of a book tells you which page a chapter starts on?

options.why: The title page shows the name of the book.
The blurb is a short description of the book.

hints: Look at the front of the book.
It lists chapters and page numbers.
Which part shows chapter names in order?
check.explanation: The contents page lists chapters and the pages they start on.
